steps.title: Fix the actual source objects and finite-time target
steps.semantic_evidence: Literal definitions and change target match the private Prop and source recurrence. Two conclusions refer to actual intervals/records; all finite values are NNReal and all possible infinities are WithTop.

steps.title: Reuse initialized monotone actual clocks on the common AE event
steps.semantic_evidence: Parent76 supplies actual initialization/time monotonicity/guarded update; parent78 supplies AE finite-horizon escape. The three facts are internal results, not added public assumptions.

steps.title: Select the predecessor of the first clock crossing
steps.semantic_evidence: Existence proof selects least k with t<T_k, proves k>0 using T0=0 and t>=0, sets n=k-1 and applies Nat.find minimality. This matches a frozen allowed route and correctly handles initialization predecessor.

steps.title: Prove that the half-open interval index is unique
steps.semantic_evidence: Symmetric monotonicity contradictions prove interval uniqueness with left<= and right<. No strict positive-wait assumption is needed, and equal adjacent times give empty intervals.

steps.title: Exclude stopped records at finite covering times
steps.semantic_evidence: Record_n=stopped would give T_n=top<=finite t, contradicted by finite<top. This links coverage to a genuine live record.

steps.title: Recover the actual live record and its stored time
steps.semantic_evidence: The chosen record a is the actual inl branch; eventTime equals a.time and lower interval bound gives a.time<=t. No independently chosen state or time is substituted.

steps.title: Keep the last live arc when the next wait is infinite
steps.semantic_evidence: Next wait top implies every finite t-a.time is below it. This preserves the last live arc and performs no phase/elapsed computation at infinity.

steps.title: Bound the elapsed offset for a finite next wait
steps.semantic_evidence: For finite next wait q, guarded actual recurrence gives next time a.time+q and postbounce phase; t<that time and a.time<=t yield NNReal tsub<q. untopD0 is not used to create live updates from top.

steps.title: Prove uniqueness of the actual live record
steps.semantic_evidence: Uniqueness of the actual time/state pair follows from Sum.inl injectivity. This is uniqueness at a fixed record index, not a stochastic-process uniqueness theorem.
